reason: The cited lines only document/declare a browser keyboard-press command with a string key parameter and mark it read-only false. They do not show arbitrary code execution on the host, so HOSTEXEC is not supported. They also do not establish whether the browser content reached may include non-public data (SECRET), whether key presses can cause data to be sent to an attacker-readable destination (SINK), or whether any returned content is attacker-controllable (UNTRUSTED); those behaviors depend on implementation and page/browser context not shown in these lines.
